facts.snippet: From that first workshop, the Older Women’s Cohousing group was formed
facts.who: Maria Brenton 与首批参与者
facts.did: 1998 年登报召集后，首场工作坊促成了 OWCH（老年女性共居小组）的成立

facts.snippet: women joining, women leaving, possible housing sites found and disregarded
facts.did: 此后近二十年间反复办工作坊、开规划会、找候选地块又放弃，成员不断加入与退出

facts.snippet: We bounded down the stairs of Barnet Town Hall, we were ecstatic.
facts.did: New Ground 拿到规划许可后，从 Barnet 市政厅楼梯冲下来庆祝

facts.snippet: how hard OWCH worked to secure eight of the flats for social housing tenants, before we moved into New Ground
facts.did: 搬入前争取到 8 套公寓留给社会住房租户，做成混合产权社区

facts.snippet: We moved into New Ground at the end of 2016. We unpacked our belongings
facts.did: 2016 年底搬进 New Ground，拆箱并布置各自公寓

facts.snippet: with an office and a kitchen where we take it in turns to cook the fortnightly communal meal
facts.did: 把最大室内空间用作 Common House，附办公室与厨房，轮流做每两周一次的集体晚餐

facts.snippet: Before we moved into New Ground, we gave much thought to what would form our philosophy
facts.who: 入住前的 OWCH 成员
facts.did: 搬入前确立八条社区价值观（合作分担、非层级结构、隐私与社区平衡等），此后每年重温

facts.snippet: There are almost as many women on the waiting list for a flat at New Ground as there are residents
facts.who: 候补女性 / 非居民成员（NRM）
facts.did: 候补名单人数几乎与住户相当，候补者以非居民成员身份参加活动、工作组并轮流做饭
